purpose: L3 after the illegal-filename binding fix, batch naming, the CUDA-offer fix and target_size_mb. Backend recorded as CUDA: this binary is llama,cuda,pdfium with no vulkan compiled, so the delta is comparable to 2026-09-10 (cuda) and NOT to 2026-09-15 (vulkan).
backend_note: Set $KNAIF_PARITY_BACKEND (cpu|vulkan|cuda) so two runs can be compared. A backend change can flip a greedy-argmax near-tie, which would otherwise be indistinguishable from the change under measurement. MEASURED, not theoretical: on 2026-09-10, with the prompt verified byte-identical on both sides, `encode clip.mp4 at crf 22` rendered -crf 23 from native on CUDA and -crf 22 from native on CPU and from Python. The two runtimes link DIFFERENT llama.cpp builds (llama-cpp-2 vs llama-cpp-python), so this is a standing property of the comparison, not a misconfiguration — see `backend_attribution.json` next to this file.

entry_points.python: uv run knaif-cli run --dry-run --backend llama-cpp --model knaif-qwen3-4b-v1
